title: Turn ACION Words Into Verbs (15s micro-cut)
voice_notes: Remix variant - reuses lesson-15-acion-to-ar audio via explicit segment keys. No new TTS.

segments.say: One English ation word can give you a Spanish noun and a Spanish verb.
segments.show:
one English word
two Spanish words

segments.say: Then take that ending off, and add ar.
Now turn it into: to generate.
Good. You did not learn four verbs. You unlocked a pattern.

caption: One -ation word = two Spanish words: generacion -> generar.
